text: TaxSEA makes metagenomic data easier interpret. Rather reading species one time, tests whether -priori defined sets taxa shift together, drawing public databases (BugSigDB, MiMeDB, GutMGene, mBodyMap, BacDive GMRepoV2) sets collated literature.
